_about: Security advisories reviewed and accepted, per repo. The weekly audit
(.github/scripts/advisory_check.py) hides these IDs from its REVIEW list, so only
new advisories show up. An advisory whose range covers a pinned version still
BLOCKs regardless. Add IDs here only after reading them.

astral-sh/uv.note: All for versions older than the pinned uv; the audit checks pinned versions separately.

cli/cli.note: All fixed before the pinned gh (each gives its fixed version); the audit checks pinned versions separately.

eza-community/eza.note: For an older eza; the audit checks pinned versions separately.

jqlang/jq.note: Ranged ones are fixed before the pinned jq. GHSA-p7rr-28xf-3m5w (no range, no fix): fuzz-harness memory bug; jq only processes local data you pass it, low risk.

neovim/neovim.note: For an older Neovim; the audit checks pinned versions separately.

rust-lang/rust.note: For older Rust toolchains; the audit checks pinned versions separately.

sxyazi/yazi.note: For an older yazi; the audit checks pinned versions separately.

z-shell/F-Sy-H.note: Fixed in 1.67.1; the pinned commit is 65 commits past it (remote theme download removed), and no machine had a stale downloaded theme.

ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh.note: dotenv plugin and themes only; neither is loaded (direnv plugin and Powerlevel10k instead), and the pinned commit is past both fixes.
